title: Which Spurious Correlations Impact Reasoning in NLI Models? A Visual Interactive Diagnosis through Data-Constrained Counterfactuals

bias_targets.methodology: Diagnosing NLI model predictions using a visual interactive dashboard to identify Data-Constrained Counterfactuals (DCCs) that reveal the model's reliance on gender stereotypes in professions (e.g., associating 'wrestler' with 'men').

Using Data-Constrained Counterfactuals (DCCs) and an interactive dashboard to identify instances where the NLI model makes stereotypical assumptions about social and family structures (e.g., automatically predicting that a man, a woman, and two children constitute a 'family').
